_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-23, AUTOMATED HALF ONLY. Both stated outcomes (W9 fingerprint matching across a line shift, W3 suppression of a rebutted finding) are re-review properties: they need the manual '## mergewatch triage' rebuttal and the step-2 push, and the suite grades the first review. fixtures#1076 suggested mustContain 'agreed independently' — deliberately not taken: that string is the generic multi-agent agreement footnote (observed on unrelated fixtures) and asserts how many agents happened to converge, not this card's contract. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output.
